notes: shape: Counter retains broad flat countertop, end supports, inset front panel and plinth with the reference overall proportions. Material review must confirm the decorative slat appearance.

The countertop/frame are usable but this panel construction is not accepted.
shape: Second counter retains the flat top, end supports and inset panels while removing the large projecting reverse board stack. Reverse reads as coherent cabinet doors with two small handles.

final_compare: Reduced counter retains flat stone top, dark end/plinth frame and coherent wood-slat material on both faces. Five-view source comparison shows no major new PBR distortion; neutral-only faceting is compensated by the retained normal map. Fresh FBX/GLB pass at 13,432 triangles.
